findings.evidence: Basic.lean:68-73 `continuous_eval_of_continuous_coeff` uses `simp_rw [eval_eq_sum_range' ...]; continuous_finsetSum`; RootMultiplicity.lean:53-61 repeats `eval_eq_sum_range'` + `tendsto_finsetSum`. `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:82: theorem hasseDeriv_zero' : hasseDeriv 0 f = f`, so the m=0 case is exactly the general eval statement. Mathlib has no family-eval continuity lemma (only `Polynomial.continuousAt` for a fixed `p`, mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Polynomial.lean:58).
findings.fix: Add `continuousAt_eval {f : X → R[X]} {r : X → R} (hf : ∀ i ≤ d, ContinuousAt (fun x ↦ (f x).coeff i) x₀) (hd : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, (f x).natDegree ≤ d) (hr : ContinuousAt r x₀) : ContinuousAt (fun x ↦ (f x).eval (r x)) x₀` to `Basic.lean`, derive `continuous_eval_of_continuous_coeff` from it (instantiate at `X × R` with `r := snd`), and prove `continuousAt_hasseDeriv_eval` as that lemma applied to `fun x ↦ hasseDeriv m (F x)` using the coefficient continuity of lines 46–52 plus `natDegree_hasseDeriv_le`.
findings.issue: `continuousAt_hasseDeriv_eval` hides the general fact (eval of a coefficientwise-continuous, locally degree-bounded family along a continuous point is continuous at `x₀`) inside the `hasseDeriv m` special shape, and re-proves the same `eval_eq_sum_range'` + `tendsto_finsetSum` argument already carried out in `continuous_eval_of_continuous_coeff`. A consumer wanting plain eval continuity along a section must pass `m = 0` and rewrite with `hasseDeriv_zero'`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Roots.lean:284 `theorem roots_prod {ι} (f : ι → R[X]) (s : Finset ι)`; Basic.lean:53 `theorem continuousAt_coeff_prod {f : ι → X → R[X]} (s : Finset ι)`; RootMultiplicity.lean:93 already calls `roots_prod _ _ ...` with the `univ` Finset.
findings.fix: Take `(s : Finset ι)`, state the product as `∏ k ∈ s, F k x`, relativise `hF`, `hdeg`, `hne` and the conclusion to `∀ k ∈ s`, and drop `[Fintype ι]`. The proof carries over: `roots_prod f s`, `Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff`, `Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le` all already take a `Finset`, and `eventually_all` becomes `eventually_all_finset`. The call site in `Common.lean:154` passes `Finset.univ`.
findings.issue: `eventually_rootMultiplicity_eq_of_prod` is stated with `[Fintype ι]` and a product over `Finset.univ`, so it cannot be applied to a product over a subfamily without re-indexing through a subtype; this is narrower than the Mathlib convention for product lemmas and than the sibling lemma in the same directory.

summary: Two generality issues: the new Hasse-derivative continuity lemma bundles `hasseDeriv m` into a statement whose real content is general eval-along-a-section continuity, re-proving the finite-sum argument already in Basic.lean; and the product-transfer lemma is restricted to `Fintype ι`/`univ` instead of the conventional `Finset`.
